About Me

I work where business systems meet network infrastructure. My career started in telecoms and network engineering and grew into ERP consulting, so I can talk to finance teams about their processes and to engineers about their networks.

I have delivered around 20 ERP and digital transformation projects across manufacturing, FMCG, telecoms, distribution and services. I work through the full cycle: discovery, gap analysis, configuration, user testing, go-live and support after launch.

I present regularly to CFOs, Finance Directors and CEOs, and I write documentation that people actually use.

Outside client work, I care about community connectivity. I have helped deploy public Wi-Fi for communities and worked on school internet connectivity proposals.

Services

How I help organisations get their systems, networks and processes working together.

ERP Implementation & Support

Odoo and Zoho implementations from discovery to go-live, including configuration, data migration, user testing, training and post-launch support.

Business Systems Analysis

Requirements gathering, process mapping and gap analysis, so the system is built around how your business really works.

Network & Wireless Infrastructure

Design, deployment and support of LAN, WLAN and community Wi-Fi using MikroTik and Ubiquiti, with monitoring and performance checks.

IT Systems & VoIP Administration

Microsoft 365 administration, VoIP (3CX, Teams Calling, Zoom Phone), user support and IT security compliance across multiple entities.

Automation & Integration

REST API integrations, workflow automation and AI-assisted processes that cut manual work and errors.
